greeting: Good morning, Senaida — it's Saturday, a rare unscheduled day to choose what gets your attention.
focus: Consider sitting at the piano for 20 minutes today with no goal, no recording — just sound for yourself
If you're feeling social, reach out to one person from WATF! or the India circuit just to check in
Protect the morning routine even though it's the weekend — meditation, breathwork, yoga, coffee
reminder: Your body holds tension in your shoulders and neck when you're spending too much time at the laptop or avoiding something creative. Notice if that's present today, and let the yoga practice be about release rather than performance.
thought: The gap between the artist you show the world and the private practice that feeds it isn't permanent — it's just waiting for you to come back.
